Kashi Dev Deepawali to Feature 1.1 Million Diyas and 2,100 Drones

Kashi is set to host a grand Dev Deepawali celebration on November 24, coinciding with Kartik Purnima. The event will illuminate the Ganga riverbanks with over 1.1 million diyas. Additionally, 2,100 indigenous drones will display imagery of Lord Shiva, Mother Ganga, and Kashi's spiritual heritage in the sky. Chet Singh Ghat will feature a 3D projection mapping and laser show.
